decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the established dumper range with a dedicated page and sunk development costs, and two years on the market is still too early to blame any weakness on anything but start-up effects.
The articulated construction dumper reflects visible engineering investment in the core construction line and fits the announced path of refining the range, so management persists with it.

The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is the firm's largest visible commitment in its lifting core, so dropping it would contradict the announced direction and write off substantial sunk costs.
The material lift line is publicly praised as the most popular rental lift and has just won a large order, so there is every reason to keep it.

Although the mining loader is distant from the core offer, the firm publicly reports strong field results of 1,000 operating hours in seven months, so its commitment is reinforced despite having withdrawn the mine rescue vehicle.
